summary: This bill allows physical therapists to participate in the National Health Service Corps Loan Repayment Program and expands Medicare coverage to include physical therapy services in rural health clinics and federally qualified health centers.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the National Health Service Corps Loan Repayment program to include physical therapists and increases funding for it. It also expands Medicare Rural Health Clinic Services and Federally Qualified Health Center Services to include physical therapy, which generally makes healthcare more accessible and affordable, aligning with more public healthcare.
Section 3 increases the NHSC loan repayment authorization by $15 million specifically for physical therapists, representing new federal spending without any offsetting cuts or revenue measures.

The bill's core provisions expand government-supported physical therapy access by adding PTs to the NHSC loan repayment program and requiring Medicare coverage of PT services in Rural Health Clinics and FQHCs, directly advancing government-led coverage expansion in underserved areas.
